title: Humanlike AI Design Increases Anthropomorphism but Yields Divergent Outcomes on Engagement and Trust Globally

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting large-scale cross-cultural experiments across 10 countries to measure differences in user anthropomorphism, engagement, and trust in response to varying levels of AI human-like design, specifically evaluating and challenging the implicit assumption of a universal AI experience derived from WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) populations.
